verdict.rationale: Exa is an API-first product, so headless use is its core mode. It ships an official JS SDK for programmatic search and answers, async Websets jobs with real-time HTTP callbacks, scheduled searches, and a single-command setup that syncs an API key into a project, all of which fit unattended automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline documentation or examples, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), a dedicated CLI, and independent hands-on reports of CI usage.
